name: SIYARAM
business_description: Siyaram manufactures and sells textiles and garments, primarily focusing on fabrics and ready-made apparel. The company generates revenue by producing and distributing these products to wholesalers, retailers, and branded outlets.
input_sensitivity: Cost risks: Margins are sensitive to fluctuations in raw material prices (cotton, polyester, viscose), energy costs, and labor expenses. Revenue/demand risks: Demand is directly influenced by consumer discretionary spending on apparel and textiles, as well as fashion and retail sector trends.
output_note: Wholesalers, retailers, and branded outlets pay Siyaram for textile fabrics and ready-made garments.
